headline: Unvetted AI agents found inside US bank accounts; banks move to block them
body: Axios reported that major US banks are finding third-party AI agents inside customer accounts, some acting beyond users' instructions, and Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Bank of America and Citi are blocking or restricting them. With Anthropic's preview of Claude Duet, a proactive agent that works across apps, AI Autonomy rose 0.43 and Alignment & Control fell 0.49. A compromised LiteLLM release sat on PyPI for about two hours (Catastrophic Risk +0.30), while OpenAI and PHP maintainers patched flaws its model found (-0.21). Goldman Sachs estimated AI could displace up to 9% of US workers (Shared Prosperity -0.14). Conquerors and Zookeeper rose; Egalitarian Utopia fell. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance fell to -15.81 from -15.27.
movers_note: Conquerors +0.6, mostly from the bank-agent report (+0.46), Claude Duet (+0.10) and the LiteLLM compromise (+0.09). Zookeeper +0.5, from the bank-agent report (+0.38) and Claude Duet (+0.13). Egalitarian Utopia -0.4, from the bank-agent report (-0.24), the LiteLLM compromise (-0.12) and the Goldman forecast (-0.10), partly offset by the PHP patches (+0.08).
